input.content:
You are an expert OOP programming teacher who creates coding challenges for a multiplayer game. You generate tasks that teach object-oriented programming concepts through hands-on coding.

RULES:
- Tasks should be solvable in 2-5 minutes
- Starter code should have clear TODOs marking what to fix
- The solution must be complete and runnable
- Validation patterns must be literal code fragments from the solution
- Keep code concise (under 30 lines)
- Generate DIFFERENT scenarios each time (not always Dog/Animal or BankAccount)
- Use creative class names like Vehicle/ElectricCar, Weapon/Sword, Shape/Hexagon, etc.
- Visible checks should be written as plain English specs
- Validation patterns should be exact code fragments from the solution

Generate a abstraction coding task in javascript.

Language syntax reference:
JavaScript OOP:
- Class: class Animal { constructor(name) { this.name = name; } speak() { return this.name; } }
- Inheritance: class Dog extends Animal { constructor(name) { super(name); } }
- Private: use #field syntax or closures. Use #balance for private fields.
- Polymorphism: override methods in subclass, no keyword needed

The task should teach the concept of abstraction through a creative, original scenario (don't use Animal/Dog or BankAccount — pick something unique and fun).

content.title: Implement Abstract Quest Details
content.prompt: In our game, all quests share common properties but display their details differently in the quest log. Implement the `getQuestLogEntry` method in the `DeliveryQuest` and `BountyQuest` subclasses, ensuring the base `Quest` class remains abstract regarding this method.
content.starter_code: class Quest {    constructor(title) {        this.title = title;        this.isCompleted = false;    }    // TODO: This method should be abstract and throw an error if called directly.    getQuestLogEntry() {        return "Generic Quest Log Entry"; // This should not be reachable in a concrete Quest instance.    }    complete() {        this.isCompleted = true;        return `${this.title} completed!`;    }}class DeliveryQuest extends Quest {    constructor(title, item, recipient) {        super(title);        this.item = item;        this.recipient = recipient;    }    // TODO: Implement getQuestLogEntry to describe the delivery task.    // Example: "Deliver the Ancient Scroll to Elderwood Village."    getQuestLogEntry() {        // ...    }}class BountyQuest extends Quest {    constructor(title, targetEnemy, count) {        super(title);        this.targetEnemy = targetEnemy;        this.count = count;    }    // TODO: Implement getQuestLogEntry to describe the elimination task.    // Example: "Eliminate 5 Goblins from the Whispering Woods."    getQuestLogEntry() {        // ...    }}
content.solution_code: class Quest {    constructor(title) {        this.title = title;        this.isCompleted = false;    }    getQuestLogEntry() {        throw new Error("Abstract method 'getQuestLogEntry()' must be implemented by subclasses.");    }    complete() {        this.isCompleted = true;        return `${this.title} completed!`;    }}class DeliveryQuest extends Quest {    constructor(title, item, recipient) {        super(title);        this.item = item;        this.recipient = recipient;    }    getQuestLogEntry() {        return `Deliver the ${this.item} to ${this.recipient}.`;    }}class BountyQuest extends Quest {    constructor(title, targetEnemy, count) {        super(title);        this.targetEnemy = targetEnemy;        this.count = count;    }    getQuestLogEntry() {        return `Eliminate ${this.count} ${this.targetEnemy}(s) from the area.`;    }}
visible_checks: A DeliveryQuest for an 'Ancient Scroll' to 'Elderwood Village' should generate a log entry like 'Deliver the Ancient Scroll to Elderwood Village.'.
A BountyQuest to eliminate 5 'Goblin's should generate a log entry like 'Eliminate 5 Goblin(s) from the area.'.
Attempting to call `getQuestLogEntry()` on a base `Quest` instance should result in an error, enforcing the abstract nature of the method.
validation_patterns: throw new Error("Abstract method 'getQuestLogEntry()' must be implemented by subclasses.");
